title: ModelVerifierOut
description: Model verification contract: operation evidence audit plus the compact AnswerVerifierOut verdict retained in the task journal.

operation_checks.description: Positive user-requested runtime operations and positively observed conditional branches only. A prohibition or other absence constraint must be checked against executed operations in the overall verdict and must never create an operation_checks row.

requested_operation.description: A positive requested operation or a conditional branch, never a forbidden or explicitly excluded action.

applicable.description: False only for a conditional branch whose condition was positively observed in evidence_step_ids. Never use false for a prohibition or absent forbidden action.

output_field_checks.description: Complete audit of every output field, key, or column explicitly named by the user. Use an empty array only when the user named no output fields. Preserve requested_field byte-for-byte from the request.

requested_field.description: One exact field/key/column token copied byte-for-byte from the user request.

exact_label_present.description: True only when requested_field is visibly present as an exact object key, table column, or explicit field label in the candidate answer.

evidence_step_ids.description: Optional non-authoritative evidence annotations. The host validates label presence against the candidate answer itself.

unsupported_claims.description: Optional machine-readable claims that are not grounded in observed evidence. An empty array has no effect; non-empty entries force an evidence-grounded rewrite.

pass.description: True when the final answer satisfies the task contract and observed evidence.

missing_evidence_fields.description: Semantic evidence fields still missing from the answer.

answer_incomplete_reason.description: Short stable reason when pass=false; empty when pass=true.

should_retry.description: True when another attempt can likely collect the missing evidence or correct the failure.

retry_instruction.description: Concise instruction for the next planner attempt; empty when no retry is needed.
